edges.reason: transfer() delegates to internal _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates to internal _transfer().
transferFrom() decrements allowance through _approve().
approve() delegates to internal _approve().
_transfer() calls burnToken() to burn contract tokens before swapping.
_transfer() calls swapTokensForEth() on sell transfers when swapEnabled.
_transfer() calls sendETHToFee() with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer() finalizes accounting through _tokenTransfer().
burnToken() re-enters _transfer() to move tokens to the dead address.
_tokenTransfer() delegates to _transferStandard().
_transferStandard() computes amounts with _getValues().
_transferStandard() allocates the team fee via _takeTeam().
_transferStandard() updates reflections via _reflectFee().
_getValues() calls _getTValues().
_getValues() calls _getRate().
_getValues() calls _getRValues().
_getRate() calls _getCurrentSupply().
manualswap() invokes swapTokensForEth() on the contract balance.
manualsend() invokes sendETHToFee() with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading() approves the router through _approve().
swapTokensForEth() approves the router through _approve().
tokenFromReflection() uses _getRate() for conversion.
balanceOf() converts reflection balance with tokenFromReflection().
createPair() performs the factory createPair external call.
swapTokensForEth() performs the router swap external call.
openTrading() performs the addLiquidityETH external call.
sendETHToFee() sends ETH to the fee address.
openTrading() approves the pair contract externally with max allowance.

onlyOwner modifier restricts createPair to the owner.

onlyOwner modifier restricts setBots to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts delBot to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts _setSellTax to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setBuyTax to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts manualswap to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts manualsend to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts renounceOwnership to the owner.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
msg.sender is used as the sender of a transfer.
msg.sender is used as owner or spender in allowance updates.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_owner is the address compared against the caller by onlyOwner.
owner() returns the state variable _owner.
_maxTxAmount caps amount plus wallet balance during transfers.
removeMaxTx gates the max transaction check in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic burn and swap branch.
_buyTax is read into _feeAddr2 for buy transfers.
_sellTax is read into _feeAddr2 for sell transfers.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from and to addresses.
uniswapV2Router is used for the token swap and WETH lookup.
uniswapV2Router is used for addLiquidityETH in openTrading.
_feeAddress receives the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_rTotal is reduced by rFee using SafeMath sub in _reflectFee.
_tFeeTotal is increased by tFee using SafeMath add in _reflectFee.
_rOwned is read to compute the token balance in balanceOf.
_rOwned balances of sender and recipient are updated in _transferStandard.
_allowances is read when checking the transferFrom allowance.
_allowances is written in _approve.
_feeAddr1 tax numerator is consumed by _getValues.
_feeAddr2 tax numerator is consumed by _getValues.
_isExcludedFromFee gates whether fee logic executes in _transfer.
bots mapping is checked to block blacklisted senders.
_rTotal bounds the rAmount require in tokenFromReflection.
_rTotal is used as the reflection supply in _getCurrentSupply.
inSwap lock flag is set around the swap external call.
tradingOpen is checked and set in createPair and openTrading.
_tOwned mapping is part of the token accounting used in transfer logic.
recipient parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into _transfer() and its SafeMath checks.
tokenAmount parameter flows into the router swap call.
amount parameter flows into the ETH transfer to the fee address.

notbot parameter flows into the blacklist mapping write.
maxTxAmount parameter flows into the _maxTxAmount write.
sellTax parameter flows into the _sellTax write.
buyTax parameter flows into the _buyTax write.
rAmount parameter flows into the tokenFromReflection division.
burnAmount parameter flows into the burn _transfer call.
tAmount parameter flows into _transferStandard value computation.
tTeam parameter flows into _takeTeam multiplication.
rFee parameter flows into the _rTotal subtraction.
tFee parameter flows into the _tFeeTotal addition.
tAmount parameter flows into _getValues tax computation.
walletBalance local is computed from balanceOf inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local is read from balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer.
burnAmount local is computed from the contract token balance in _transfer.
path array local is built for the router swap call.
currentRate local is read from _getRate in tokenFromReflection.
tTransferAmount local is computed in _getTValues.
tFee local is computed from the tax rate in _getTValues.
tTeam local is computed from the team rate in _getTValues.
rAmount local is computed from tAmount and currentRate in _getRValues.
rSupply local is read from _rTotal in _getCurrentSupply.
Router swap external call may re-enter _transfer before state is settled.
ETH transfer to the fee address may call back into sendETHToFee if the address is a contract.
addLiquidityETH may invoke callbacks on the pair and token contracts.
